project_type: LIVE k3s cluster operations over SSH (NOT a buildable code repo). Changes are kubectl applies/patches to a running Intel-GPU OpenVINO Model Server (OVMS) deployment plus an OmniRoute app Deployment. A stale local workspace manifest copy is synced last.
build_system: None. There is no local build. 'Build' = applying manifests/patches to the live cluster and observing pod health.
test_framework: None in the traditional sense. Verification = kubectl pod-status watches + live HTTP calls to the embeddings API (public https://omniroute.celestium.life and in-pod http://localhost:8000). Auth bearer at /run/secrets/omniroute_management_api_key (35 chars) for the public management API.
build_command: N/A — apply with: ssh -o BatchMode=yes celes@192.168.42.254 'kubectl -n <ns> apply -f <remote-manifest>' or kubectl patch/set env for live-only edits.
test_command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes celes@192.168.42.254 'kubectl -n omniroute-memory get pods -l app=ovms-embeddings -w' (health) and in-pod/public POST /v1/embeddings returning a 1024-dim vector.
verification_instructions: Per design F7 + acceptance criteria: (1) re-verify live state before any mutation (mem limit, probe shape, graph max_length, ConfigMap presence, per-replica ping, qdrant revision); (2) roll ONE surface at a time, verifying health between steps; (3) embeddings single-replica rolls use StatefulSet rollingUpdate.partition (3->2->1->0), NOT OrderedReady (podManagementPolicy=Parallel is immutable); (4) after each step confirm pods READY with no climbing restarts, a live POST /v1/embeddings returns a 1024-dim vector, an over-ceiling request is cleanly rejected, and memory limits applied with no OOMKill/Pending. Reset partition to 0 after RC1/RC3 success.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The OVMS graph.pbtxt is GENERATED by OVMS on the model PVC (header: 'File created with: OpenVINO Model Server 2026.4.0'), NOT shipped. Regenerate it in place non-destructively with 'ovms --configure --model_path /models/OpenVINO/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-int8-ov --task embeddings --pooling LAST --truncate=true --max_length 8192 --target_device GPU' (fallback: --overwrite_models). NO PVC wipe. Acceptance: 'grep max_length graph.pbtxt' on the live pod reads the configured value.
environment_constraints: SSH: ssh -o BatchMode=yes celes@192.168.42.254 (host esnixi, k3s). kubectl patch/create works WITHOUT sudo for: patch deploy in ns omniroute, patch sts + create cm in ns omniroute-memory (auth can-i = yes). CRITICAL BLOCKER: remote ~/sources/kube/omniroute/omniroute.yaml is ROOT-OWNED and passwordless sudo is NOT available for celes — so the live OmniRoute env change MUST be applied via 'kubectl set env'/'kubectl patch' (no file write needed), and reconciling the on-disk omniroute.yaml file needs sudo; if sudo is unavailable, apply live via kubectl (source of truth) and report the file-reconcile for the user to finish manually. The ~/sources/kube/omniroute/ DIRECTORY is writable (a .bak copy can be created). qdrant StatefulSet is OFF-LIMITS — never touch it. Do NOT roll all four embedding replicas at once (cluster is at times fully 0/4; use the partition).
contribution_requirements: This is remote-cluster ops, not the menagerie git repo, so AGENTS.md code rules (ESLint suppressions, Vitest, SettingsView) do NOT apply to the remote changes. Keep the remote .bak convention before editing any remote manifest file (pattern: <file>.yaml.bak-<desc>-<UTC-timestamp>, e.g. omniroute.yaml.bak-fetchtimeout-20261009T015116Z). Commit the LOCAL workspace manifest sync (FEAT-005) on the branch; never push. Do NOT create .changeset files or edit CHANGELOG.md.
key_patterns: Live embeddings readiness probe is an INLINE exec: curl -sf -m 2 -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/embeddings ... input 'ping', timeoutSeconds 3, periodSeconds 5, failureThreshold 3. The COMMITTED manifest instead mounts /opt/readiness/embed-probe.sh (exec, timeout 5, failThresh 4, period 15) from ConfigMap ovms-readiness-scripts (currently NotFound live). Committed embed-probe.sh posts to /v3/embeddings and asserts EXPECTED_DIM=1024; the live inline probe uses /v1 — BOTH endpoints exist on the pod; reconcile the script to whichever serves a 1024-dim vector on a HEALTHY replica. Reranker live probe is tolerant HTTP /v2/health/ready (do NOT clobber; the committed rerank-probe.sh /v3/rerank 404s live). OVMS image digest openvino/model_server@sha256:e7a448ec...c40e8e (2026.4.0). Exact OmniRoute ceiling env var: OMNIROUTE_EMBEDDING_SPLIT_MAX_ITEM_TOKENS (default 4096, currently UNSET on the deploy). Overflow enum OMNIROUTE_EMBEDDING_ITEM_OVERFLOW = auto(default)|truncate|reject; leave at auto. OVMS does NOT truncate over-length input (it errors), so app-layer auto is the only truncation backstop.
